title: Make preview geometry ownership transactional and instance-safe
description:
Harden CreaturePreviewController generated-object ownership. Current editor preview state is persisted through global SessionState keys, while geometry registration happens only after GameObject/component/material setup succeeds. A failure during attachment can therefore leave an unregistered generated object, and multiple controller instances can contend over the same global ownership record. Establish one preview-instance ownership authority with transactional registration/cleanup and explicit generated-Mesh lifetime. Preserve the ability to recover a surviving preview across editor reloads without allowing stale objects from another controller/session to be adopted accidentally.
